howto.text:
How to try it

• Press Play, then click inside once so it has the keys.
• The sidebar has Upcoming and Undated under Today, Completed and Trash after the lists. ⌃1–9 here (⌘ in the app) open its first nine rows.
• Upcoming: drag a row onto another day, or ⌥⌘↑ ⌥⌘↓ to move it a day. A day's + adds for that day.
• Delete a task, then find it in Trash; ⌘⌫ there puts it back.
• ? lists every key.

upcoming.text: Upcoming · each open task once, on the day it reaches Today: the earlier of its When and Deadline. The next seven days always show, then months. A deadline on its own day reads “Due”. Drag a row onto a day to set When, never past its deadline.

undated.text: Undated · open tasks with no When and no Deadline, grouped by list like Today. Drag reorders within a list; a group's + adds to that list. Giving a task a date takes it out, with a notice and Undo.

completed.text: Completed · the logbook: every completed task, newest first, a group per day for the past week, then per month. Unchecking puts it back in its list after 1.5 s. No +: ⌘N adds in the default list.

trash.text: Trash · deleted tasks, newest first, read-only. Put Back (⌘⌫, the menu, the details' ↶) returns a task to its list at its old place. No delete forever.
